# .env.example — copy to .env and fill in real values for local development.
# Nothing in this file is a real credential; every value below is a
# placeholder describing the expected shape.

APP_ENV=development
APP_PORT=8080
LOG_LEVEL=info

DATABASE_URL=postgres://appuser:changeme@localhost:5432/appdb
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0

SESSION_SECRET=replace-with-a-long-random-string
MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS=notifications@example.com
MAIL_SMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com
MAIL_SMTP_PORT=587

FEATURE_NEW_DASHBOARD=false
FEATURE_BETA_EXPORTS=false
